title: When I cry Ya Hussayn
body:
When I shout ya Hussayn
When I cry ya Hussayn
When I shed all my tears
Ya Hussayn Ya Hussayn
Every day Ashura
Every land Karbala
Every word that we say, is
Ya Hussayn Ya Hussayn
When we lift up your flag - we remember your name
When the world all as one - calls to you O' Hussayn
We will stand by your side - as we know you're our guide
In our hearts you remain - Ya Hussayn Ya Hussayn
When Muharram arrives and our tears start to flow,
And the love in our hearts for Hussayn only grows
We will raise up our arms, we will send our salaams
Every 10th we will cry - Ya Hussayn Ya Hussayn
As we walk to your shrine in our minds we reflect
How you fought for Islam we will never forget
But today you're alive, and your message will thrive
Running through our veins, Ya Hussayn Ya Hussayn
They will never destroy - they will never erase
All the love that we have - for our master Hussayn
Every night, every day - every place, everywhere
We will echo the cry - of Labbaik Ya Hussayn
We will never submit to the likes of yazid
They have martyred Hussayn but we are his seeds
We will show them our way, we will never betray
Our Blessed Imam, Ya Hussayn Ya Hussayn
So today we await - the Imam of our time
Who will bring peace on earth to the whole of mankind
Al Ajal Ya Imam - Ya Imame Zamaan
We will follow your cry - of Labbayk Ya Hussayn
